companyContext: Danish family-owned toy manufacturer founded in 1932 in Billund by Ole Kirk Kristiansen. The LEGO Group designs, produces and distributes LEGO® brick-based building sets and play experiences sold in more than 120 countries, with a mission to inspire and develop the builders of tomorrow through the power of play.
brandContext: LEGO® Pokémon™ is a multi-year collaboration between The LEGO Group and The Pokémon Company International, launched in 2026. The range lets fans build iconic Pokémon (Pikachu, Eevee, Venusaur, Charizard, Blastoise and more) in LEGO brick form, spanning collectible display sets for adults and interactive SMART Play™ playsets for kids — bringing the Pokémon Trainer journey to life, brick by brick.

typography.fontUses: Logo lockup and LEGO® wordmark only — never use for body copy
Hero headlines and campaign titles (e.g. 'LEGO® Pokémon™ — Catch them all, brick by brick')
Subheadings and section titles on product pages
Body copy, product descriptions, paragraph text
Co-branded Pokémon™ wordmark / decorative key-art accent only (never long copy)

brandVision: Réunir deux univers iconiques de l'imagination — la brique LEGO et le monde Pokémon — pour offrir aux fans une nouvelle façon, tangible et créative, de vivre leur aventure de Dresseur. Inspirer les bâtisseurs et dresseurs de demain à travers le jeu, la collection et la nostalgie partagée, brique après brique.
brandValues: Imagination, créativité, jeu, qualité, nostalgie partagée, plaisir intergénérationnel, esprit de collection, découverte (« Attrapez-les tous »), et partenariat respectueux entre deux marques emblématiques. Play Well — Leg Godt.
